title: ACadSharp package/source provenance and 3.8.0 failure envelope
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Reconcile ACadSharp NuGet package freshness with GitHub source release/tag state
Refresh a concrete issue reproduction against its exact reported package and source commit
Check current ACIS writer and ACDS/ACIS prerequisite PR deployment status
Improve optional peer admission without changing local implementation order or validation cadence

sources.observation: NuGet lists ACadSharp 3.8.0 as the current package, last updated 2026-09-21, with earlier packages 3.7.16, 3.7.1 and 3.6.51 also present. The package page does not, in the inspected content, bind 3.8.0 to an immutable source commit.

The reviewed GitHub Releases page still marks v3.7.1/tag d7dc111 as latest, while NuGet publishes a 3.8.0 package. The package and source release therefore require separate identity fields unless an immutable mapping is proven.

The report states that an R2009 GeoData class-version-1 tail omission and related unit field issues were reproduced with NuGet 3.8.0 and master commit 4cd7759 using two private drawings. This is corroborating peer failure evidence with unavailable artifacts, not a format authority or local reproduction.
The ACIS entity writer proposal remains open and not deployed. It depends on PR #1174 and cannot qualify a released DXF ACIS writer.

The ACDS/ACIS schema refactor remains open. A branch-specific discussion comment reports an embedded-record test failing because its reader path was not implemented at that time; this is not a claim about an arbitrary later package.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Added an exact package-versus-source provenance requirement for optional ACadSharp comparisons and refreshed the known GeoData/ACIS peer evidence boundaries. No local defect, implementation item, or support claim was added.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue the existing local-ready implementation queue; no peer dependency or external qualification prerequisite is added.

method.limitations: Package and issue pages are time-sensitive. NuGet metadata and GitHub Releases expose different version identities, and the exact 3.8.0 source mapping was not established. The GeoData reproductions use private drawings unavailable for independent inspection. No peer package was downloaded or executed.
